title: introduce-latency-decay-histogram-and-alert-calibration-wizard
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: long-tail token latency and cost spikes have been hard to diagnose because our histograms compress older samples uniformly, masking decay behavior from warm kernels and gradual queueing. This PR adds a decay-weighted latency histogram data structure, a backend sampling adapter to emit decay-aware rollups, and a small interactive 'Alert Calibration' wizard in the Console to help SREs tune alert bands based on realistic decay curves and per-route token shapes.

What this includes: - A new decay_histogram collector that stores bucketed counts with exponential decay weights (configurable half-life) so recent tokens influence percentiles more while preserving historical context. - An ingestion adapter that converts existing per-invocation phase timings into decay-weighted increments and emits compact rollups to the observability index. - Console UI: wizard that shows live preview of how different half-lives and bucket schemas change p50/p95/p99 for selected routes and token-length cohorts. It outputs suggested alert thresholds with rationale and an auto-generated patch for the route's alert policy. - Migration: SQL migration to add decay bucket metadata for existing rollups. Backfill is optional (disabled by default) and runs as a rate-limited job to avoid IO spikes. - Tests: end-to-end integration tests that validate numeric stability and sampling parity vs a non-decay baseline for steady-state traffic. - Docs: new observability guide and runbook with examples for tuning.

Rollout plan: feature gated by 'decay_histograms' feature flag. Stage 1: enable collector in staging and validate telemetry indexes. Stage 2: enable Console wizard for SRE users (dry-run mode that does not modify alert policies). Stage 3: enable auto-patch suggestions and open PRs to update route alerts by opt-in. Monitoring: added internal SLI to ensure backward compatibility on cardinality and query latency (target <5% overhead on query times).

Checklist: - [x] Implementation of decay histogram collector - [x] Ingestion adapter + compact rollup schema - [x] Console wizard UI + preview - [x] SQL migration & optional backfill - [x] Integration tests + unit tests - [x] Docs and runbook - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan

Related work: this complements ENG-2087 (prompt-shape cohorts) and should reduce false-positive alerting we saw during the 2025-12 incident. Linear: ENG-4321, ENG-7765.

Notes: the decay parameters are conservative by default (half-life = 30m) and can be tuned per-tenant or per-route. The migration adds a small metadata column and will not change any query surface unless flag is enabled.
commits: feat(observability): add decay_histogram data structure and serializer
feat(ingest): decay-weighted rollup adapter + migration script
ui(console): alert calibration wizard and histogram preview
review_comments: Arjun Patel: This looks promising. Two quick asks: 1) can you add a unit test that compares decay vs vanilla histogram on synthetic burst traffic? 2) make sure the migration is reversible (rollback script).
Maya Thompson: Added the synthetic burst test and a down migration. Also added a note in the runbook about rate-limited backfill to avoid IO storms.
Leah Kim: UI nit - the preview legend needs clearer labels for half-life vs window size. Also prefer defaults to be tenant-safe; backing off to 1h half-life was suggested.
Maya Thompson: Updated the labels and bumped default half-life to 1h. Kept ability to set per-route overrides. Pushed an extra commit for the UI text changes.
Diego Martinez: CI flaked on a linting step earlier; saw it rerun cleanly. Approving once CI green.
Arjun Patel: Approving. Would like an observability alert to track query latency overhead; please add a short-term SLI entry.
Maya Thompson: Added SLI (observability.query.latency.decay-index) and included it in the rollout plan.
release_notes: Added decay-weighted latency histograms to surface recent token latency behavior without losing historical context.
New Console 'Alert Calibration' wizard to preview and suggest alert thresholds using decay-aware rollups.
Feature gated; disabled by default. Admins can opt-in per-tenant or per-route.
Includes optional rate-limited backfill; see docs/observability/latency_decay.md for migration guidance.
